notes.title: God's Trigger launches amidst a hail of bullets
notes.notes:
God’s Trigger is out now, and unmistakably a big, loud tribute to Hotline Miami. Developed by One More Level, it takes the formula of Dennaton’s hyper-lethal top-down shooter and bolts on (local now, online next month) co-op play, magic powers and a modern-day mythical story. Controlling a remarkably fragile angel-and-devil duo (tag-teaming if you play solo), there’s a whole lot of shooting to be done between them and their targets; the four horsemen of the apocalypse. See the launch trailer below, focusing on the horsemen and their big set-piece boss fights.

(more…)

notes.title: Slay with Style - Get Creative with Special Abilities
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32942895/e9bf1d0bf43678c5a8cf300e9fa772c3bf657df4.jpg[/img]

Ever wondered what it’s like to have powers from both [b]Heaven and Hell[/b]?

[b]God’s Trigger[/b] allows you to go on the rampage as [b]Harry, a fallen ange[/b]l, or [b]Judy, a demon[/b]. Each of them has[b] 7 unique abilities[/b] that players can [i]upgrade, customize and combine[/i] with others to create their own visceral style of dishing out death. In God's Trigger where any hit is fatal, [b]slowing down time[/b] to dodge bullets or to [b]becoming invisible[/b] will be key to survival.
 

In the [b]solo[/b] campaign, players will be able to [i]seamlessly switch between the two characters[/i] at anytime and have access to all of their respective skills and powers. Partner up with a friend in [b]co-op[/b] to create even deadlier and more [i]explosive combos[/i], crushing enemies in no time and making the most of the [b]14 abilities and 36 weapons[/b] the merciless duo has at hand.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=TB4gH9oMrZA&feature=youtu.be

[b]Dear Angels & Demons[/b],
Our main goal is to create a game accessible for all.  Unfortunately many times we've been told that God’s Trigger is [b]too difficult[/b] and [b]too graphic[/b] so we would like to announce few changes that will make it to [i]the final game[/i].

We decided to delete the whole [b]skill-based gameplay[/b] and replace it with [i]non-moving, non-shooting enemies[/i]. [b]One-hit-deaths[/b] – a wise man once said  'Game overs' are a failure of game design so forget about this feature of game and [b]play GT forever![/b]

Sit back and get ready for April 18 full of [b]red bouquetes[/b] made with r[b]ose red -color of love and affection[/b].

notes.title: Introducing: Judy
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32942895/bb69c65cc6216b6a9244507492d7af4de672b112.png[/img]

They say that good girls go to Heaven, but [b]Judy goes anywhere she wants[/b].

After [b]escaping from Hell[/b], Judy has been trapped on Earth and thoroughly enjoying every minute of it. Unfortunately, the starting [b]Apocalypse[/b] threatens to ruin everything for her. 

Fighting with her [b]bladed chain[/b] (or anything that isn’t nailed down) and making deadly use of her demonic powers, [i]she’s the perfect yang for Harry’s yin[/i]. Together they will stop the end of the world and probably grab a drink afterwards. 
 
Judy stars in a ballet of blood and explosions that is God’s Trigger.[i] Grab a shotgun, summon a Wall of Fire, infuse your bullets with hellish energies, and destroy your enemies[/i] in the most spectacular way imaginable.

notes.title: Introducing: Harry
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32942895/a05bd228441e32815b1228c42cc41057ddb82604.png[/img]

Ever heard about [i]Angel of Mercy?[/i] [b]Well, Harry isn’t that kind of angel...[/b]

A disgraced [b]soldier of Heaven[/b], he lost his wings and was cast out to Earth where he’s fighting for the fate of the World.
Wearing his distaste for humanity on his sleeve, he’ll[b] carve a path of destruction with his sacred blade[/b] to save everyone... even if he has to kill them first.
 
In God’s Trigger there is no place for boredom - use Harry’s [b]customizable Special Abilities[/b], [i]make split-second decisions, dodge bullets, use weapons[/i] and dispatch violence in the [b]most brutal, over-the-top way possible[/b].
